from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyFinancialMetric(BaseModel):
    """One company's net profit attributable to shareholders of the parent company from a single report."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The full company name as written")
    stock_code: str | None = Field(description="The stock/security code of the company")
    reporting_period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period covered by the report")
    metric_name: str | None = Field(description="The line-item name as written, e.g., '归属于上市公司股东的净利润'")
    net_profit_attributable_to_parent: float | None = Field(description="The net profit amount in yuan; negative if a loss")
    currency_unit: str | None = Field(description="Currency unit, e.g., '元'")
    source_section: str | None = Field(description="Which section of the report the value appears in")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    company_financial_metrics: list[CompanyFinancialMetric]
